title: Final bullet velocity expression
description: Essential: The response must provide the final expression for the bullet's initial velocity in terms of M, m, s, h, and g.

title: Conservation of momentum
description: Important: The solution must apply momentum conservation to relate the bullet's initial velocity to the combined post-collision velocity.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly analyze the horizontal and vertical projectile motion of the combined mass after the collision to find its velocity.

title: Correct algebra
description: Important: The derivation must correctly combine the momentum and projectile equations to solve for the bullet's initial velocity.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expression should be dimensionally consistent, having units of velocity.

title: Incorrect momentum assumption
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution assumes energy conservation for the inelastic collision instead of momentum conservation.

title: Sign or factor error
description: Pitfall: Penalize for algebraic errors in the final expression, such as incorrect factors (e.g., missing 1/2, misplaced square root).
